Output / Stub generator
* "gcd" isn't defined anywhere in the statement. Please use the full term instead.

Cases
* Please restore the original case names for the validators (Validator 1, Validator 2, etc).

* Please revise the cases so that each pair covers one of the following scenarios (and expects different outputs) rather than merely swapping [[a]] and [[b]]:

  • a > b and output > 1 and a is multiple of b

  • a = b and output > 1

  • a < b and output > 1 and b is multiple of a

  • a = 0 and b > 1

  • a > 1 and b = 0

  • a = 1 and b > 1

  • a > 1 and b = 1

  • a > b > 1 and output = 1

  • 1 < a < b and output = 1

  • a > b and output > 1 and a is not multiple of b

  • a < b and output > 1 and b is not multiple of a

* Please use as many values between 0 and 1000 as possible in a balanced manner across the cases.

Thanks.
